rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for relevance or a connection between things.

example.english: This matter has no bearing on us.
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 dei6 mou5 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this for a person's sense of orientation or ability to know where they are going.

example.english: I had a poor bearing when I was young and often took the wrong road.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣方向感好差，成日行錯路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 fong1 hoeng3 gam2 hou2 caa1 sing4 jat6 haang4 co3 lou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the mechanical part that supports a rotating shaft and reduces friction.

example.english: The machine's bearing is broken and needs replacing.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅軸承壞咗，要換新嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 gei1 ge3 zuk6 sing4 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a technical compass bearing or horizontal angle in navigation and surveying.

example.english: The surveyor measured the bearing with an instrument.
example.traditional: 測量員用儀器量方位角。
example.jyutping: caak1 loeng4 jyun4 jung6 ji4 hei3 loeng4 fong1 wai6 gok3
